title: Irrigation Equipment and Systems - Evaluation of Field Irrigation Efficiencies - Guidelines
clause_1_scope: 1.1 This standard lays down the guidelines for evaluation of field irrigation efficiencies in respect of the following irrigation methods: i) Border strip, ii) Check basin, iii) Furrows, iv) Sprinkler, and v) Drip. This standard also includes field irrigation efficiency, moisture, characteristic irrigation time and characteristic irrigation curve that are used for evaluating irrigation efficiency.

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
